rationale: Fixed assignment layout target hash matches the same learner JSON e5a21bef9e626c082f91b2a950365d740523370dbc1447295511da61b12bfc5d. N13 lesson copy, IR and learner views are shared from the original frozen files; r2 does not duplicate them. Original source-first observations and R07 conditions are retained.

The complete Page diff against P001 is one added rule: .w048-reading-flow .reading-derivation-chain .reading-formula-expression{justify-content:flex-start;justify-items:start}. Its specificity is (0,3,0). It overrides the ordinary .reading-formula-expression rule (0,1,0), so ordinary flex content is now aligned to the start.

The <=350px Q05 rule in global.css:1463-1474 has selector .reading-derivation-chain[data-derivation-id="n13-q05-chain"] [data-testid="textbook-formula-n13-wm023-q05-right"] .reading-formula-expression, plus the sibling final-row selector. Each has specificity (0,4,0). It explicitly sets display:grid, justify-content:center and justify-items:center. The r2 rule loses on specificity even when injected later; the promised left edge remains unimplemented for both Q05 case rows at the required 320px width.

The same generic specificity limitation also applies to existing N14 narrow-grid selectors, but the concrete N13 Q05 counterexample alone is sufficient to reject this N13 layout target. No new lesson authoring or product/Store/Git mutation was performed.

Revision gating still restricts the scoped class/style to N13 r5 or N14 r11. Number prop, font contract, source figure gates, projection and old-save static ordering from epoch1 remain unchanged. No actual computed style, DOM alignment or browser persistence result is claimed.
